campaigns.core_idea: Address the specific, recurring seasonal concern of fasting-related skin dehydration directly -- a credible, non-generic alternative to the usual 'Ramadan sale' framing most beauty brands default to.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Women experiencing dry, dull skin during fasting hours, searching for a real fix rather than a discount.

execution_directions.direction: A bundled two-step routine (hydrating cleanser + barrier repair moisturizer) positioned as a proactive fix for the month, not an impulse buy.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Matches actual purchase intent during Ramadan -- people are searching for a solution, not browsing for a deal.

execution_directions.direction: A short, credibility-first educational Reel explaining why fasting changes skin hydration, ending on the routine fix.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Leads with expertise rather than a sales pitch, which fits Glowly's ingredient-transparency positioning better than a straightforward promo would.

campaigns.core_idea: Speak directly to the ingredient-literate audience already following the skin cycling method, positioning Glowly's existing products as a ready-made routine rather than launching anything new.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Skincare-engaged customers already familiar with skin cycling -- higher purchase intent than an impulse browser, since they already know what they're looking for.

execution_directions.direction: Bundle the Vitamin C Serum (active night) and Barrier Repair Moisturizer (recovery night) as a labeled two-product cycling set.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Low production cost -- it's existing inventory repackaged with clearer usage guidance, not a new product.

execution_directions.direction: An educational Instagram Carousel walking through a 4-night cycle using the two specific products.
execution_directions.why_it_works: This audience wants to understand the 'why', not just be told to buy -- carousel format suits a short structured explanation.

campaigns.core_idea: A reasonable stretch -- not a fashion brand, but 'skin prep before a big event' is a legitimate use case that fits the SPF/serum lineup without pretending to be something the brand isn't.
campaigns.target_audience_angle: Women attending Fashion Week events or similar occasions wanting visibly better skin fast, in the days leading up to a specific date.

execution_directions.direction: A short-term mini kit (Vitamin C Serum + SPF 50) framed as a 5-day pre-event prep routine, sold as a one-time purchase.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Ties directly to a specific, time-bound occasion rather than an ongoing routine, which fits an impulse purchase pattern better.

execution_directions.direction: A day-by-day TikTok mini-series building anticipation toward event day.
execution_directions.why_it_works: The countdown format creates a natural reason to keep watching and re-engaging over multiple days rather than a single post.
